name: Slice-based SDF Voxelization
definition: A voxelization technique that computes a Signed Distance Field (SDF) for a triangle mesh by iterating over a 3D grid, determining inside/outside status via ray-casting parity on 2D slices, and sampling the exact mesh distance at each voxel center.
summary: Slice-based SDF Voxelization computes signed distance fields by using 2D slice ray-casting parity to determine inside-outside status, distinguishing itself from methods relying on global propagation.
